History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has a 5-day history of feeling generally unwell with cough and cold symptoms.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 5/7 hx of generally unwell with cough and cold sx.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies chest pain but is feeling more short of breath.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No chest pain. Feeling more SOB.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports feeling hot/cold and sweaty, but has had no fevers.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Feeling hot/cold and sweaty. No fevers.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Associated symptoms include a sore throat, blocked ears, and a runny nose.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sore throat and blocked ears. runny nose.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is experiencing myalgia and arthralgia, described as joint stiffness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Also myalgia and arthralgia - mainly stiffness in joints.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had an initial episode of diarrhea which has now resolved.
Patient reports no unwell contacts and no nausea or vomiting.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension.

Medications.content: Patient takes metformin, lisinopril, and aspirin.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with his wife and works in a factory/manufacturing.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: SH: lives with wife, works in factory/manufacturing

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient smokes socially and consumes more than 9 units of alcohol per week.

Assessment.content: The impression is a viral upper respiratory tract infection (URTI) with a possible lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI).

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised conservative management including rest, increased fluid intake, and regular paracetamol.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Conservative mx - rest, fluids, regular paracetamol

Plan_of_Care.content: A delayed prescription for Amoxicillin was provided, to be started in 24-48 hours if symptoms do not improve.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Delayed script for amoxicillin abx - to start in 24-48 hours if sx not improving

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to have a review in one week if not better.
Advised to seek review earlier for worsening symptoms such as chest pain, shortness of breath, or fevers.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: or earlier if worsening sx (chest pain, SOB, fevers)
